title: Masou Gakuen HxH Specials
justification: AniList 97936 (SPECIAL, 6 episode(s) from 2016-09-30) is AniDB 11638's special(s) S1-S6, aired 2016-09-30 to 2017-02-24. AniList's PARENT relation names AniList 21378, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 11638. The parent has no mapping row, so S1-S6 default to TVDB 307112 0x1-0x6, which carry the same titles (Kunoichi Aine, Yurishia, Hayuru's Diary, Reiri & Bunny, Sylvia Taros, Peeping Incident) on the same dates.
